<!-- All news items below this line -->
'''Business and economy'''
*[[President of the World Bank Group|World Bank President]] [[David Malpass]] announces he will resign by the end of June. [https://www.rfi.fr/en/business-and-tech/20230215-world-bank-chief-david-malpass-to-step-down (AFP via RFI)]
*The [[FTSE 100 Index]], the main [[Stock market index|share index]] of the 100 most highly [[Market capitalization|capitalized]] companies listed on the [[London Stock Exchange]], ends its [[trading day]] at a record value of 8,003.65 points, surpassing the previous record value of 7,906.58 points recorded on February 3, 2023. [https://www.deccanherald.com/business/business-news/london-ftse-100-index-breaks-through-8000-points-1191625.html (AFP via ''Deccan Herald'')]

'''Disasters and accidents'''
*[[Gualaca bus crash]]
**At least 39 migrants are killed in [[Gualaca District]], [[Chiriquí Province]], [[Panama]], when their bus, heading to the [[United States]], falls off a [[cliff]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/americas/least-33-migrants-die-pamana-bus-crash-official-2023-02-15/ (Reuters)]
*[[2022–23 South Pacific cyclone season]]
**Five people are killed by [[Cyclone Gabrielle]] in [[New Zealand]]. [https://www.rte.ie/news/world/2023/0215/1356728-new-zealand-cyclone/ (AFP via RTÉ)]
*Eleven people are killed and 73 others are missing and presumed dead after [[List of migrant vessel incidents on the Mediterranean Sea|a boat carrying migrants sinks]] off the [[Libya]]n coast. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-64651096 (BBC News)]
*At least 10 people are killed by [[avalanche]]s in [[Tajikistan]]. [https://www.rferl.org/a/tajikistan-avalanches-heavy-snow/32272766.html (RFE/RL)]
*Two people are killed after a [[Sikorsky UH-60 Black Hawk]] helicopter crashes in [[Madison County, Alabama|Madison County]], [[Alabama]], United States. [https://apnews.com/article/accidents-tennessee-alabama-a91baaec82e54a670f1eb6d7fa370fd2 (AP)] 
'''International relations'''
*A [[United Nations]] report says that former [[Egyptian Army]] [[colonel]] [[Saif al-Adel]] has become the new leader of [[Islamic terrorism|Islamic terrorist]] group [[al-Qaeda]] and is currently residing in [[Iran]] [https://www.france24.com/en/live-news/20230215-us-says-iran-based-saif-al-adel-is-new-al-qaeda-chief (AFP via France 24)]

'''Law and crime'''
*[[2022 Buffalo shooting]]
**Payton Gendron receives ten [[life sentences]] without the possibility of [[parole]] for the [[mass shooting]] at a supermarket in [[Buffalo, New York]], which killed ten people. [https://www.nbcnews.com/news/us-news/man-rushes-buffalo-grocery-mass-shooter-emotional-sentencing-hearing-r-rcna70250 (NBC News)]
*One person is killed and three others injured after a mass shooting in a shopping mall in [[El Paso]], [[Texas]], [[United States]]. [https://www.reuters.com/world/us/one-shot-dead-three-wounded-texas-mall-shooting-2023-02-16/ (Reuters)]
*An investigation by a [[consortium]] of journalists uncovers a major [[disinformation]] campaign by an [[Israel]]i firm named [[Team Jorge]], led by ex-Israeli [[special forces]] member [[Tal Hanan]], which is alleged to have influenced more than 30 elections in several countries. [https://www.theguardian.com/world/2023/feb/15/revealed-disinformation-team-jorge-claim-meddling-elections-tal-hanan (''The Guardian'')]

'''Politics and elections'''
*[[Nicola Sturgeon]] announces that she is resigning as [[First Minister of Scotland]] and [[Leader of the Scottish National Party]] once a new leader [[2023 Scottish National Party leadership election|is elected]]. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/world/2023/02/15/scotland-nicola-sturgeon-resigns/ (''The Washington Post'')]
*[[President of Kazakhstan|Kazakh President]] [[Kassym-Jomart Tokayev]] signs a law annulling many privileges of his predecessor [[Nursultan Nazarbayev]], including lifetime financial support from the state, and the right to address the nation and propose ideas to officials, and also deprives Nazarbayev's immediate family of legal immunity. [https://www.rferl.org/a/kazakhstan-nazarbaev-family-legal-immunity-stripped/32273034.html (RFE/RL)]
